method: Read-only SHA256 of extracted Mach-O images; parse LC_SEGMENT_64 mappings and compare cached function .bin byte-for-byte to image; inspect decompilation and selected original assembly anchors. No original-function emulation, packet capture, or real-headunit test performed in this review.
evidence_scope: Local sender paths, not a complete end-to-end conformance certificate
